decision_metric: concurrency_speedup_vs_serial=(T_omma+T_imma)/T_dual and dual_time_over_slowest_standalone=T_dual/max(T_omma,T_imma). Independent subpipes approach the latter ~=1; shared serialization approaches concurrency speedup ~=1.
design: 128-thread block: even warps execute 16 native sparse FP4 OMMAs/loop; odd warps execute 16 native sparse S8 IMMAs/loop. Standalone kernels use the same warp positions and geometry; dual kernel enables both.
runtime_gate: Existing run_2pf_guarded.sh; no production stop/signal from this probe. Correctness runner compares dual outputs against standalone OMMA/IMMA outputs before accepting timing.
